newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Perez Companc, Williams win Concepcion oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Perez Companc, Williams win Concepcion oil contract.

text.p: Argentina's Perez Companc in association with the Williams Companies Inc of the U.S., agreed Tuesday to pay $153 million for the contract to operate Venezuela's La Concepcion oil field, state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) said.
Four other consortia bid for the field, on the second day of Venezuela's third round of oil operating contract auctions.

The field, discovered in 1924 on the shores of Lake Maracaibo in western Venezuela and once worked by a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell group before industry nationalization in 1976, produces 2,500 barrels per day (bpd) from 40 active wells.
The field has proven reserves of 44 million barrels, according to PDVSA estimates, with 188 other inactive wells.
